title: Root identity excludes revision and suitability status
test_intent: Determine whether mutable revision and suitability/status values are kept outside the canonical root container identity.

applicability.applies_when: A governed information container has a canonical root identity and carries revision or suitability/status information.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The subject is not governed by the S4 canonical container identity rules.

result_logic.pass: Revision and suitability/status are represented as mutable metadata or revision dimensions associated with the stable root identity and do not alter that root identity.
result_logic.fail: Revision or suitability/status is embedded as a defining part of the canonical root identity such that changing the mutable value creates a different root identity.
result_logic.not_applicable: The subject does not use the governed canonical container identity model.
result_logic.indeterminate: The root identity or the associated revision/status metadata cannot be distinguished from available evidence.

provenance.migration_note: First conformance pilot ATS derived directly from the existing S4 requirement and curator decision separating stable identity from mutable metadata.
